report:
Reviewed the complete selected_semantics claim and all four implementation associations, both ordinary tests, and the explicit TODO test. Requirements are retaining the selected function, dispatch family, separate owner and method substitutions, trait-call Self and trait reference, and permitting proof without a concrete impl identity. ResolvedCallTarget stores function/dispatch/owner_type_args/method_type_args; StaticTrait stores self_ty and TraitRef and deliberately has no mandatory impl field. The newly associated method.rs constructs trait targets from the selected trait function, Self and trait ref after a Yes certainty result; it constructs external inherent targets with Direct and splits type arguments at owner_type_count. The supported trait-method subset requires only Self and no method generic types; unsupported candidates are not silently selected. operator.rs constructs StaticTrait targets with the operator function, left Self, retained owner trait predicate, owner [left,right] and empty method arguments. finalize.rs copies the chosen function unchanged, dispatch tag unchanged, and recursively resolves/copies Self, trait arguments, and both substitution slices into the completed stash. These associations include the essential target construction and completion code in future freshness checks.

The ordinary clone test requires no diagnostics, a ResolvedCall selecting clone, StaticTrait dispatch identifying Clone, ADT Self consistent with the receiver field type, and the explicit receiver reference/dereference chain. Its captured synthetic metadata declares Clone with Self only, a shared receiver, and Self result. The ordinary operator test uses the captured Left + Right -> Sum fixture; assertions inspect the completed call, selected add name, exactly two owner arguments with concrete Left and Right symbols, and Sum output, with no diagnostics. Helpers used to locate symbols and run the supplied database callback twice were captured; these do not hide these assertions. Together the tests detect wrong function selection, erased trait dispatch/Self and lost or swapped nontrivial operator owner substitutions. They do not claim full method-generic or direct-dispatch substitution coverage.

The todo::types_calls_selected_semantics entry expressly defers complete direct/static substitution scenarios and generic trait calls. It is accepted as a visible test-coverage deferral, not as an executed behavioral test. Full generic trait-call end-to-end coverage requires expanding method selection beyond the represented Self-only subset; direct and static substitution test matrices remain future fixture/assertion work. The current data representation and copying support separate substitution sets, while this review does not label these deferred scenarios tested. The proof qualification is represented structurally: successful construction uses trait certainty and retains the selected trait-method symbol, not a required impl identity.

Executed cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call (1 passed); cargo test -p sage-oracle-harness --test binary_operators local_operator_impl_can_choose_distinct_rhs_and_output (1 passed). These executions are separate from the source assessment and do not remove the explicit TODO. Added only essential association comments to check/method.rs, check/operator.rs and check/finalize.rs. Centralized post-codegen and Sage sanity reviews are assigned to the coordinator.
